subject: Weekly exec update — wins, chokepoints, QBR asks (Acme)
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly exec update — wins, chokepoints, QBR asks (Acme)

Team — quick weekly exec snapshot and three asks ahead of Acme QBR next week. Keeping this tight so leadership can FYI / escalate if needed.

Wins
- Serving: rolled out continuous-batching pools for small-chat workload; p50 token throughput improved ~22% (see dashboard).
- Cost: initial quantized 4-bit variants dropped average token cost by ~18% on dedicated clusters for internal benchmarks.
- Onboarding: closed pilot with Finera (internal) — 2 customers migrated to Dedicated trial in last 30 days.

Chokepoints / Risks
- Latency variance: p99 for long-context (6k tokens) spiked during yesterday's afternoon traffic surge; root cause points to uneven KV-cache shard distribution on the pool (SRE investigating).
- QBR readiness risk: Acme asked for finalized SLO language + new cost-per-1M estimate by COB Tue prior to their prep; our deck is in draft and needs numbers validated.
- Marketplace integration: partner marketplace listing blocked by an open security questionnaire item (data residency Q), awaiting partner response.

Asks (owners & ETA)
1) Deck + SLOs: Maya to push final Acme QBR deck v2 -> share by EOD Wed (2026-06-03). Attachment: QBR_deck_acme_v2.pdf (draft).
2) Latency root cause & mitigations: Markus to run canary with even-shard KV distribution and report p99 delta by EOD Thu (2026-06-04).
3) Pricing estimate: Laura to validate cost-per-1M tokens (hosted + dedicated delta) and confirm the numbers we present in the deck by Wed noon.

Quick notes:
- Relevant dashboards: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/qbr/acme (perm: exec view).
- Attached: QBR_deck_acme_v2.pdf (draft), p99-latency-trends.csv (raw).

If there are no objections I will mark the deck as "leadership pre-read" by EOD Wed and request a 30-min run-through slot on Thu.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly exec update — wins, chokepoints, QBR asks (Acme)

Thanks Vivek — useful recap. Two quick requests: 

1) On the latency spike, can you include p95/p99 numbers broken out by model family (gpt-open-<x> vs redwood-verified) and by deployment type (hosted vs dedicated)? I need those for the QBR appendix.

2) For pricing, give both blended and conservative estimates (conservative = assume no quantization for dedicated). Acme will ask about worst-case.

Also, let's not mark the deck "leadership pre-read" until the SRE mitigation plan is clear — we should call out the canary plan and rollback criteria.

Happy to join the run-through — pls pencil me in for Thu 10:30 PT if that works.

Laura Bennett
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly exec update — wins, chokepoints, QBR asks (Acme)

Laura — good calls, all noted. Quick inline answers and updates: 

> p95/p99 broken out by model family and deployment
We pulled the short window (last 72h) report; attaching p99-latency-trends.csv — includes model-family labels and deployment tags. Summary: hosted p99 (gpt-open-7b) = 520ms; dedicated p99 (gpt-open-7b quantized) = 640ms (the higher is due to cache-miss amplification on longer contexts).

> Pricing: blended and conservative estimates
Working numbers: blended = $8.40 per 1M tokens (assumes 40% quantized on dedicated); conservative = $11.20 per 1M tokens (no quantization). Laura — will you confirm conservative pricing by Wed noon?

> Canary & rollback
Markus: propose canary (10% traffic) with even-shard KV distribution, 4-hr observation window, rollback if p99 degrades >10% or error rate increases >0.2pp. Can you confirm ownership + ETA?

Forwarding below the customer note from Acme that triggered the urgency — they want final SLO phrasing. FYI.

-- Forwarded message --
From: Alex Jones <alex.jones@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 16:44:12 -0400
Subject: Acme QBR agenda & pre-read request
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the update earlier. Quick ask — can you share the SLO wording and cost projection for next Thursday's QBR? Our procurement team will want to see the conservative numbers. Also curious whether Redwood can commit to a regional guardrail for EU traffic (we have some EU customers we may route).

Alex
Alex Jones
Head of Integrations, Acme Cloud
alex.jones@acme.com

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly exec update — wins, chokepoints, QBR asks (Acme)

I'll take the canary. Plan: deploy even-shard KV distribution to a 10% canary pool by 02:00 PT Thu (6/4), monitor p95/p99 and error rate for 4h. If p99 improves or stays within +-5% and error rate stable, we'll roll to 30% then full; rollback criteria as defined.

I will also update the deck notes with the canary plan and rollback bullets so we can share that in the pre-read.

Markus
Director, SRE
Redwood Inference
